To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

we have generalized the concept of cyclic pursuit to the case of generalized cyclic pursuit, where the agents pursue a point that is the weighted centroid of the remaining agents, which can be used to control the motion of the agents.

we have proposed a new decentralized control scheme for swarm control, called generalized centroidal cyclic pursuit (GCCP), which can achieve the desired behaviors of a swarm of mobile agents, and we have analyzed the behavior of the GCCP scheme.
by suitably choosing the agents gain, the rendez-vous point of the agents, the directed linear motion and the trajectories of agents can be controlled.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the control of a swarm of agents using centroidal cyclic pursuit laws.
controlling the behaviour of a swarm of agents using a decentralized control scheme.
the design of generalized pursuit laws for swarm of agents such that, by selecting the gain appropriately, the motion of the agents in the swarm can be controlled.
